title: Handley Page Halifax R9438
memorial_details:
Granite Block. Halifax R9438 of 35 Squadron flew into Fitful Head whilst on an operation against the German Battleship Tirpitz on 31/3/42

The granite block memorial stands on the clifftop above the crash site.
inscription: TO THE MEMORY OF / THE CREW OF HALIFAX R 9438 (H), 35 SQUADRON, / WHO CRASHED INTO THE CLIFFS HERE ON RETURNING FROM / AN AIR RAID ON THE TIRPITZ, 30/31st MARCH 1942: / (7 names)

sources.title: Facebook post by Tony Hibberd (admin, RAF Bomber Command Memorials group), citing Chorley BCL Vol 3; photos by South Mainland Community History Group

cause_of_loss: Crashed into cliffs below Fitful Head on return
community_connection: The memorial was photographed by Kieran Murray, Ray Woolmer and Donald Robertson of the South Mainland Community History Group, who maintain a record of this remote clifftop site.
narrative: On 31 March 1942, Halifax R9438 (TL-H) of 35 Squadron, operating from RAF Kinloss, crashed into the cliffs below Fitful Head, Shetland, on the return leg of a raid against the German battleship Tirpitz. All seven crew were killed.
